## ✅ Quality Checklist

Please verify your submission meets these requirements:

### For New Sources:
- [ ] Source is actively maintained (updated in last 6 months)
- [ ] Content is high-quality and reputable
- [ ] Link is working and accessible
- [ ] Not a duplicate of existing sources
- [ ] Description is clear and concise
- [ ] Proper markdown formatting used
- [ ] Placed in appropriate category/section

### For All PRs:
- [ ] I have read the [Contributing Guidelines](../CONTRIBUTING.md)
- [ ] Markdown formatting is correct
- [ ] Links are tested and working
- [ ] No spelling/grammar errors
- [ ] Follows the existing style and format
- [ ] Alphabetical order maintained (where applicable)
